description: Plano de transporte público de Sant Joan Despí is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sjdespi.net. Map of public transport in Sant Joan Despí is a set of geographical information regarding the route of the urban bus and the location of the public transport stops in the municipality of Sant Joan Despí. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Map of public transport in Sant Joan Despí" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Sant Joan Despí, Transport públic, Transport planning, Estació d'autobús, Estación de autobús, Planificació del transport. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
